events.title: Our Demo Is Now Available!
events.summary: Hello everyone!We’re BigPicture, the team behind Underveil.We drew inspiration from deckbuilding roguelikes like Slay the Spire, as well as games like Backpack Battles, where you strategically place and combine items.Many of us on the team had a blast playing Slay the Spire 2. At some point, we started wondering:“What if we removed card costs from the deckbuilding games we love?”And that’s how Underveil was born.In Underveil, it’s not just about picking powerful cards.
